title: Anchored Onramp Gesture Map and Screen Montage
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design an anchored hero canvas for the Quickstart landing that pairs a gesture-based map (illustrated path with step anchors) with a montage of live product screenshots. The goal is to communicate 'first successful inference' in one view: clear entry steps, expected time-to-value, and a real UI preview layered in a scenic composition. Deliverables: responsive hero mockups (desktop/tablet/mobile), Lottie-friendly motion spec, static fallback sprites, annotated screenshot exports, accessibility contrast and reduced-motion variants, and developer handoff tokens/exports.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop hero (1440px) with anchored gesture map + 3-step screenshot montage approved by PM
Tablet and mobile responsive variants with stacked anchors and collapsible screenshot carousel
Motion spec (Lottie + CSS fallback) includes initial load, step highlight, and screenshot swap; reduced-motion variant provided
Assets exported and named per token convention (hero_step1_desktop.png, hero_step1_mobile@2x.png, etc.)
Design handoff file with component tokens, spacing scale, and image slices shared to engineering and SRE for perf constraints
QA checklist for visual regression and localization (strings, screenshot overlays) is attached

comments: 2026-03-02 | Maya Chen: Initial exploratory sketches uploaded to Figma. Two directions: scenic montage (story-first) vs. utility-first (checklist-forward). PM prefers story-first but with clearer CTA anchoring.

2026-03-05 | Priya Shah (PM): Leaning towards keeping the hero copy to a single line and using microcopy below screenshots to avoid crowding. Please include time-to-first-inference estimate overlay (average/median) — we can pull from analytics dashboard.
2026-03-07 | Rafael Ortega: Prototype for screenshot carousel implemented; needs guidance on GIF vs. frame swap for perf. Raised question: should we show a 'private deployment' ribbon variant?

2026-03-08 | Security (Aisha Kumar): For private deployment ribbon, ensure no customer PII in screenshots. Use synthetic data and a visible 'DEMO' watermark. Also request KMS iconography to be subtle (non-branded).

2026-03-10 | Motion Designer (Ethan Li): Added Lottie timeline. Suggest step highlight as 250ms fade + 350ms slide to reduce cognitive load. Added reduced-motion switch that changes animation to cross-fade only.
2026-03-12 | Rafael Ortega: Submitted design handoff to engineers and linked PR for static assets. Waiting on SRE perf review for sprite bundling. Planning final review with PM on 2026-03-14.
decision_log: 2026-03-04: Opted for story-first scenic composition after PM review; added a pinned CTA anchor to prioritize conversion
2026-03-06: Chose screenshot montage over single large screenshot to show multiple product surface areas (API quickstart, console rollout, observability)
2026-03-09: Motion spec finalized to favor short, low-friction transitions and provide a reduced-motion variant for accessibility
notes: Localization: screenshot microcopy must be extractable; avoid rendering text inside rasterized screenshots when possible. Provide localized screenshot overlays (en, fr, de, ja)
Performance: recommend lazy-load screenshots and provide low-res placeholders (blur-up); team to coordinate with SRE for prefetch of hero assets on route hover
Accessibility: color contrast for anchors must meet WCAG AA; focusable anchor elements with visible focus ring; keyboard flow to allow skipping carousel
Privacy: use synthetic data and blur any telemetry in screenshots; watermark DEMO on private/on-prem variants
